content.text:
/en/admin/content -> 200 <title>Content | OpenCulturas</title>
/en/node/add/event -> 200 <title>Create Event | OpenCulturas</title>
/en/admin/config/content/openculturas_map -> 200 <title>OpenCulturas - Map settings | OpenCulturas</title>
/en/admin/content/locations -> 404 <title>Not found | OpenCulturas</title>
/en/admin/people -> 200 <title>People | OpenCulturas</title>

observation.command: cd /workspace && ULI=$(su ddevuser -c "ddev drush uli" 2>&1 | grep -o 'http[^ ]*login' | head -1); curl -s -L -c /tmp/c.txt -o /dev/null "$ULI"; for u in /en/admin/content /en/node/add/event /en/admin/config/content/openculturas_map /en/admin/content/locations /en/admin/people; do code=$(curl -s -b /tmp/c.txt -o /tmp/a.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://openculturas.ddev.site$u"); t=$(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/a.html | head -1); echo "$u -> $code $t"; done
